criteria.criterion: Evidence-backed height, floors, and roof form
evidence: Purdue Athletics and the architect page describe a three-level facility; the source supports three levels but does not provide measured elevations.
Asset height is 14.55 m, explicitly estimated. No surveyed elevation or construction drawing was found.

Purdue GIS reports 115,053 sq ft, while Purdue Athletics and Populous report 112,000 sq ft. The GIS footprint is 5418.6 m², so three complete floor plates would imply about 1.92 times the published area; the model places full-footprint plates at all three levels, although the sources do not establish that every story spans the full plan.

Populous describes a bold roof line resembling two planes in flight. The model includes split roof slabs and a projecting sloped entrance canopy, but the main roof slopes are very subtle compared with the dramatic folded profile visible in the official entrance photo.
criteria.reason: Three levels and the flight-inspired roof concept are source-backed, but precise vertical dimensions are absent and the full-floor geometry / roof profile only partially resolves the source evidence.

criteria.status: major features present; some facade interpretation
evidence: The asset includes a glass curtain wall, old-gold/black cladding palette, projecting entrance canopy, splayed columns, Purdue P, 1228 address, and named entry fascia; these features appear in Purdue Athletics, Populous, and FRP project photographs.

The three-quarter preview shows the massing and continuous glazed banding, while the entrance preview exposes the canopy and columns. The facade is otherwise regularized and the interior is schematic.
criteria.reason: Key identity-bearing exterior features are represented and source-backed; exact bay rhythm and hidden facades remain interpreted, and the roof-edge treatment is simplified.
